imageUrls.title: Image URLs
imageUrls.description: Direct links to images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF first frame, TIFF, SVG, HEIC where supported). Duplicate URLs are processed once.

datasetId.title: Or take image URLs from a dataset
datasetId.description: For example the output of a scraper run. Use together with "URL field".

urlField.title: URL field in that dataset
urlField.description: Field holding the image URL or an array of URLs. Dotted paths work, e.g. "media.images".

format.title: Output format
format.description: WebP is supported everywhere and small. AVIF is smaller but slower to encode.

quality.title: Quality (1-100)
quality.description: Lower = smaller files. 75-85 is visually lossless for most photos.

lossless.title: Lossless (WebP/AVIF/PNG)
lossless.description: Keeps every pixel exactly. Files are bigger.

maxWidth.title: Maximum width (px)
maxWidth.description: Shrinks to fit, keeps the aspect ratio, never enlarges. 0 or empty = keep size.

maxHeight.title: Maximum height (px)
maxHeight.description: Shrinks to fit, keeps the aspect ratio, never enlarges. 0 or empty = keep size.

keepMetadata.title: Keep metadata (EXIF, GPS, ICC)
keepMetadata.description: Off by default: metadata (including GPS location) is removed, which also makes files smaller.

skipIfLarger.title: Keep the original if conversion would make it bigger
skipIfLarger.description: Only when the format stays the same and no resizing is requested.

concurrency.title: Parallel downloads
concurrency.description: How many images to download and convert at the same time.
